documents.title: Vendor due diligence summary
documents.text:
Vendor due diligence summary: Thornbury Software (fictional, authored test material).
Throughout the documents of this review, the Target means Thornbury Software. Thornbury Software had pension deficit of €18.6m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Thornbury Software, run-rate EBITDA in FY2024 was €20.6m (reported basis). Capex as share of sales at the Target stood at 12.1% in FY2025. Lumen had net revenue retention of 132.7% in FY2025. The earn-out trigger for Thornbury Software is understood as follows: measured on reported EBITDA.
